name: bld6_tsum_lucas_div_two_pow
informal: Uses Mathlib2.calc_tsum_fib_div_two_pow and Mathlib2.lib_p3_lucas_cast: by lib_p3_lucas_cast L_n = 2F_(n+1) - F_n in ℝ; ∑ F_n/2^n = 2 (calc_tsum_fib_div_two_pow, also giving summability), and dropping the zero term n = 0 gives ∑ F_(n+1)/2^n = 2·2 = 4; so the sum is 2·4 - 2 = 6.
